heading: Firing loop
text:
### Firing loop [IRET.11.4]

`ds_rete_run(engine, max_fires, fires_out)`:

1. While the agenda is non-empty and `fires_out < max_fires`:
   a. Pop the highest-priority non-refracted activation.
   b. Call `before_fire` hook.
   c. Evaluate the activation's RHS actions in order.
   d. Call `after_fire` hook.
   e. Mark the activation's token identity (hash + fact-id
      tuple) as refracted in the terminal's refraction set.
   f. Increment `fires_out`.
2. Return `DS_OK` (agenda drained) or `DS_ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n_plus

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n_prefix
idris.note: Every prefix of a possible run is possible.

idris.name: iret_11_4__report
idris.note: Executable view of a bounded run: halt reason, firings, final working memory, pending activations per rule.

idris.name: iret_11_4__summary
idris.note: Compact run report: halt reason, firings, counts per kind, pending per rule.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace
idris.note: The states of a run as Idris literals -- how the witness proofs' states were obtained; each is then re-checked by `Refl`.

idris.name: Iret_11_4__halt
idris.note: Why a bounded run stopped: `Quiescent` is the clause's `DS_OK` (agenda drained), `FuelOut` its `DS_ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run
idris.note: The loop with `max_fires` as fuel, returning the final state, the halt reason and the firing count (`fires_out`).

idris.name: iret_11_4__step
idris.note: One iteration of the loop: select the highest-priority non-refracted activation (1a), run its RHS actions in order (1c), mark it refracted (1e). The `before_fire` / `after_fire` hooks (1b, 1d) observe and do not change the state, so they have no model. `Nothing` is the empty agenda.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n
idris.note: n iterations, `Nothing` if the agenda emptied first.

idris.name: iret_11_4__just_inj
idris.note: `Just` is injective.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms
idris.note: The bounded loop, returning state, halt reason and firing count.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_agrees
idris.note: THE AGREEMENT THEOREM for one step: on an explicit-only program the step with truth maintenance is the core's step, table empty.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n_agrees
idris.note: And for every run: everything proved about the core engine, `lcyc_1_1__certified_terminates` included, holds of this engine on those programs.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n_tms
idris.note: n firings, `Nothing` if the agenda emptied first.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms
idris.note: One firing with truth maintenance: the core's selection and pop, then the RHS with the table and the cascade in the loop. Hooks are observers, as for the core.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net
idris.note: The bounded firing loop, reporting how it halted and how many fired.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net
idris.note: One firing: select, mark fired, run the RHS actions in order; nothing pending, nothing done.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_fires
idris.note: The bounded run from the due state: one firing then quiescence.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_idle
idris.note: The bounded run with nothing to fire: quiescent at once.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__step_fires
idris.note: One firing of the follow-up: select, mark, the RHS.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_run_projects
idris.note: WITH NO RULE SITED THE RUN PROJECTS: state, halt and trace, for any fuel. By induction on the fuel through the firing's projection.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_called
idris.note: The run, traced: Rete/RunFold.idr's traced fold over the called firing.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__run_called_inv
idris.note: The called run keeps the invariant, for any fuel. By induction on the fuel through the firing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_unique
idris.note: A run keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_unique
idris.note: One firing keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_view
idris.note: A RUN keeps the view, however it halts.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net_view
idris.note: ONE FIRING keeps the view: marking, then each action.

idris.name: idat_6_2_2__mark_acts_count
idris.note: Marking an unfired activation lowers the terminal's unfired count by one.

idris.name: idat_6_2_2__mark_net_count
idris.note: And over the chains: marking the selected activation lowers the count by one.

idris.name: iret_11_4__map_just
idris.note: A mapped option that is something was something.

idris.name: iret_11_4__map_nothing
idris.note: A mapped option that is nothing was nothing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__plus_zero
idris.note: A sum is zero only when both parts are.

idris.name: iret_11_4__succ_not_zero
idris.note: A successor is not zero.

idris.name: iret_11_4__unfired
idris.note: The unfired activations of a terminal, counted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__unfired_count
idris.note: The unfired activations over every chain: what a run has left to fire.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_marks_all
idris.note: THE LOOP, COUNTED: under an action-free program each iteration pops one unfired activation and marks it, so with fuel enough the loop runs once per unfired activation, returns with the agenda drained, and `fires_out` is that number.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_net
idris.note: One iteration of the loop, naming the ordinal popped: steps 1a to 1e on the plain network.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_net_just
idris.note: What an iteration that fired did: the selection, the activation, the mark and the RHS.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_net_step
idris.note: The named iteration is the loop's step.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced
idris.note: The loop, traced: the ordinals popped, in order, with the engine and the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced_by
idris.note: THE TRACED RUN IS THE ONE TRACED FOLD at its named firing (Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__trace_by`), by induction on the fuel. The bridge the trace-is-the-run goes through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced_core
idris.note: The trace is the loop's: the same engine, the same halt, `fires_out` is its length.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net_nothing_select
idris.note: An iteration that fired nothing selected nothing: the agenda was empty.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_of
idris.note: The loop's observable: its trace and its halt.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_frame
idris.note: THE RUN UNDER THE FRAME, on the traced plain run: over any fuel, from any state with the invariant, a framed chain's tuples never change, its firings in the trace are exactly its activations that went from unfired to fired, and if the run halts `Quiescent` every one of them fired. Whatever the other rules do, however the run halts: fuel is not assumed to suffice.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__step_frame
idris.note: ONE FIRING UNDER THE FRAME: the invariant is kept, and the framed chain is as it was unless it is the rule that fired, when exactly the activation selected, unfired before, is marked and nothing else of the chain moves. The firing rule's RHS, emits and withdraws alike, leaves the framed chain because none of its writes is a kind the chain reads.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__two_rules_trace
idris.note: The loop on the two-rule fixture, traced: `[0, 0, 1, 1]`, quiescent. Executed.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net
idris.note: One iteration of the loop on the clocked network, naming the ordinal popped: steps 1a to 1e with the cascade of each action.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net_fires
idris.note: An iteration whose selection resolves fires it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net_just
idris.note: What an iteration that fired did: the selection, the activation, the mark and the RHS.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net_nothing_select
idris.note: An iteration that fired nothing selected nothing: the agenda was empty.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net_step
idris.note: The named iteration is the loop's step.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced
idris.note: The loop on the clocked network, traced: the ordinals popped, in order, with the network and the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_by
idris.note: THE TRACED CLOCKED RUN IS THE ONE TRACED FOLD at its named firing (Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__trace_by`), by induction on the fuel. The bridge the trace-is-the-run and the two step-wise unfoldings go through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_cons
idris.note: One iteration that fired, then the loop from the network it left: the loop unfolded one firing at a time, which is how an executed run is checked firing by firing. RunFold's `iret_11_4__trace_by_cons` through the bridge.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_core
idris.note: The trace is the loop's: the same network, the same halt, `fires_out` is its length.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_end
idris.note: An iteration that fired nothing ends the loop on the empty agenda. RunFold's `iret_11_4__trace_by_end` through the bridge.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_of_ttl
idris.note: The loop's observable on the clocked network: its trace, its halt, the kinds left live.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_of_ttl_inv
idris.note: The observable determines the loop's halt and trace.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_frame_ttl
idris.note: THE RUN UNDER THE FRAME on the clocked network: over any fuel, from any state between actions with the invariant, a framed chain's tuples never change, its firings in the trace are exactly its activations that went from unfired to fired, and if the run halts `Quiescent` every one of them fired. Whatever the other rules do and whatever their endings cascade, however the run halts: fuel is not assumed to suffice.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__step_frame_ttl
idris.note: ONE FIRING UNDER THE FRAME on the clocked network: the invariant is kept, and the framed chain is as it was unless it is the rule that fired, when exactly the activation selected, unfired before, is marked. The cascade of every action is inside: it retracts targets of rows, of emitted kinds, which the chain does not read.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__two_facts_fuel_out_ttl
idris.note: THE RUN THAT RUNS OUT OF FUEL: the two-fact fixture with fuel 1 -- A fires for its first match and the fuel is spent, `FuelOut`, trace `[1]`, B's match made and unfired, A's second match unfired. One firing as a `Refl` from the literal, then the run with no fuel, chained.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fired_run
idris.note: The traced run from the fact, with fuel 3, named so the tick after it is spelled once. A fixture.

idris.name: iret_11_4__observed
idris.note: The loop's observable: `fires_out`, the halt, and the agenda's tuples.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_just
idris.note: A run that fires is the firing then the rest, one more firing counted. RunFold's `iret_11_4__run_by_just` through the bridge.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_marks_all
idris.note: THE LOOP, COUNTED, on the plain network: each iteration pops one unfired activation and marks it, so with fuel enough the loop runs once per activation and returns with the agenda drained.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_nothing
idris.note: A run from a state with nothing selected: the state, quiescent, no firing. Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__run_by_nothing` through Rete/NetworkRefraction.idr's bridge `iret_11_4__run_net_by`; Rete/NetworkTransfer.idr's `iret_11_4__run_net_quiet` is the same fact read on the engine alone, from the same two.

idris.name: iret_11_4__unfired_count_is_act_count
idris.note: And over the chains: before any pump the unfired count is the agenda's size.

idris.name: iret_11_4__unfired_is_length
idris.note: A terminal of unfired activations has as many unfired as activations.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_ordered
idris.note: A RUN keeps the order, however it halts.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net_ordered
idris.note: ONE FIRING keeps the order: marking, then each action.

idris.name: iret_11_3__select_spec_agrees
idris.note: STEP 1a IS THE MODEL'S SELECTION under a sound ghost: refraction refuses nothing the flag does not.

idris.name: iret_11_4__first_eligible
idris.note: Step 1a within one rule: the first activation neither popped nor refracted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__first_eligible_unfired
idris.note: Within a rule, step 1a picks the first unfired activation when every refracted identity is fired.

idris.name: iret_11_4__map_ext
idris.note: Two maps over a selection agree when the functions agree on pairs.

idris.name: iret_11_4__mark_g
idris.note: Step 1e: the fired activation's identity enters its terminal's set.

idris.name: iret_11_4__mark_sound
idris.note: Step 1e keeps the ghost sound.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_g
idris.note: The bounded run with the set beside it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_g_by
idris.note: THE GHOST'S RUN IS THE STATE OF THE ONE FOLD at its step: it keeps no halt and no count. By induction on the fuel; with `iret_11_4__run_net_by` and RunFold's simulation, `iret_11_4__run_g_fst`.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_g_fst
idris.note: The ghost's run is the model's run.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_by
idris.note: THE NETWORK'S RUN IS THE ONE FOLD at its step, by induction on the fuel. The bridge to Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__run_by`; the module's unfoldings of the run are RunFold's through it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_sound
idris.note: A RUN keeps the ghost sound, however it halts.

idris.name: iret_11_4__select_from
idris.note: Step 1a from ordinal r on: the lowest ordinal with an eligible activation, then its first.

idris.name: iret_11_4__select_from_unfired
idris.note: From any ordinal on, step 1a's selection is the model's when every refracted identity is fired.

idris.name: iret_11_4__select_head
idris.note: The head rule's two selections agree.

idris.name: iret_11_4__select_spec
idris.note: Step 1a as the clause states it: the first non-refracted, unpopped activation in agenda order.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_g
idris.note: One firing with the set beside it: 1a select, 1e mark, 1c the RHS.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_g_fst
idris.note: The ghost's firing is the model's firing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_sound
idris.note: ONE FIRING keeps the ghost sound: marking, then each action.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__run_timed
idris.note: The firing loop over the gated stamped firing, the fuel its budget. LESS than the clause: no hooks, and refraction is the activation's flag, as every run tie of the lane.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_2__run_timed_projects
idris.note: The firing loop with stamps is the firing loop, fuel for fuel, firing for firing.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__fire_idle_timed
idris.note: No selection on a chain with no activation.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_fires_timed
idris.note: One firing, then quiescence, through the traced fold's unfoldings.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_idle_timed
idris.note: No activation, no firing, quiescent at once.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net
idris.note: A run with truth maintenance on the network, under fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_by
idris.note: THE NETWORK'S RUN WITH TRUTH MAINTENANCE IS THE ONE FOLD at its step, by induction on the fuel. The bridge to Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__run_by`; the module's unfoldings of the run are RunFold's through it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_just
idris.note: A run on the network that fires continues from the fired state with one less fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_nothing
idris.note: A run on the network that cannot fire returns the state, quiescent.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_fires
idris.note: A firing of FireLoopTms with a token selected marks it and runs its rule's actions with the table in the loop.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_net
idris.note: One firing with truth maintenance on the network: selection and mark, then the RHS with the table and the cascade in the loop.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_net_fires
idris.note: A firing of the network with an activation selected marks it and runs its chain's actions with the table in the loop.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_net_quiet
idris.note: A firing of the network with nothing selected is no firing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_quiet
idris.note: A firing of FireLoopTms with nothing selected is no firing.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__run_tms_agree
idris.note: A RUN AGREES under any fuel: the same firings, the same halt, the same count.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__step_tms_agree
idris.note: ONE FIRING AGREES: both engines stop, or both fire the same activation of the same rule, record the same rows, cascade alike, and agree afterwards.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_tms_net
idris.note: One firing, naming what fired: the terminal ordinal and the fired match's fact ids, with the engine after it -- step 1a made visible.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_tms_net_step
idris.note: The named firing is the firing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net
idris.note: One firing on the clocked engine, naming what fired: the terminal ordinal and the fired match's facts, with the engine after it -- step 1a made visible, the facts themselves so a runner can evaluate what the firing's effects read.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_ttl_net_step
idris.note: The named firing is the clocked firing.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_traced
idris.note: The pump, traced: the firings in order, the engine, and the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_traced_core
idris.note: THE TRACE IS THE PUMP'S: the same engine, the same halt, and as many firings as the pump counted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced
idris.note: The clocked pump, traced: the firings in order, each with its facts, the engine, and the halt. What Fixture.idr runs.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_core
idris.note: THE TRACE IS THE CLOCKED PUMP'S: the same engine, the same halt, and as many firings as the pump counted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__map_S_just
idris.note: A successor-mapped position that is some position was some position.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by_fl
idris.note: FIRELOOP'S RUN IS THE ONE FOLD at its step, by induction on the fuel. The bridge to Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__run_by`; the module's unfoldings of the run are RunFold's through it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_fires
idris.note: A run of FireLoop that fires continues from the fired state with one less fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_fires
idris.note: A run of the network that fires continues from the fired engine with one less fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_quiet
idris.note: A run of the network that cannot fire returns the engine.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_quiet
idris.note: A run of FireLoop that cannot fire returns the state.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_fires
idris.note: A firing of FireLoop with a token selected marks it and runs its rule's actions on its facts.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net_fires
idris.note: A firing of the network with an activation selected marks it and runs its chain's actions on its match: pop, evaluate the RHS, mark refracted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_net_quiet
idris.note: A firing of the network with nothing selected is no firing: the agenda is drained.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_quiet
idris.note: A firing of FireLoop with nothing selected is no firing.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__run_agree
idris.note: A RUN AGREES under any fuel: both quiescent together, or the same firings in the same order, and the agreement after.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__step_agree
idris.note: ONE FIRING AGREES: both engines stop, or both fire the same activation of the same rule and agree afterwards.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__step_fire
idris.note: A FIRING AGREES: with the same activation of the same rule selected on both sides, both mark it, both run the rule's actions on its facts against one working memory, and the results agree.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_well

idris.note: The state alone: a run that cannot fire returns its state.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by_just
idris.note: A run from a state the step fires: the firing, then the run from the state it leaves, one more firing counted. Proved once of the fold; each engine's unfolding is this through its bridge.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by_nothing
idris.note: A run from a state the step refuses: the state, `Quiescent`, no firing. Proved once of the fold; each engine's unfolding is this through its bridge.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by_sim
idris.note: SIMULATION: a step shadowed by another through a projection -- the projection of the one step's result is the other step at the projection -- runs shadowed by it, for any fuel: the projection of the one run's state is the other run's. Rete/NetworkRefraction.idr's ghost run shadows the engine's by this.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by
idris.note: THE BOUNDED RUN, TRACED, over any firing that names what fired: what fired, in order, with the state and the halt. The traced loops of Rete/NetworkFrame.idr and Rete/NetworkFrameClocked.idr, once; Rete/NetworkTraced.idr's, whose firing names two things, keeps its own.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_cons
idris.note: The traced fold unfolds one named firing at a time: a firing that resolves prepends what it named to the trace of the run from the state it leaves.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_core
idris.note: THE TRACE IS THE RUN'S, for any firing whose state is the step's: the traced fold and the fold reach one state with one halt, and the run counts as many firings as the trace names. The two bridged per-engine trace-is-the-run theorems are this through their bridges.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_end
idris.note: A firing that resolves to nothing ends the traced fold `Quiescent`, whatever fuel is left.

idris.name: iret_11_4__fire_start
idris.note: At the start of a firing, after the pop: the run invariant is kept and the popped activation is tracked -- its reading from the settled table, its liveness from the mark.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_by
idris.note: THE ENGINE'S RUN WITH TRUTH MAINTENANCE IS THE ONE FOLD at its step, by induction on the fuel. The bridge to Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__run_by`; the module's unfoldings of the run are RunFold's through it.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_just
idris.note: The engine's run, unfolded by one firing. Shared by Rete/TtlSweep.idr and Rete/NetworkTmsTransfer.idr, which each carried a copy.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_nothing
idris.note: The engine's run on an empty agenda: quiescent, no firings, whatever the fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_n_tms_inv
idris.note: Every state of a run satisfies the run invariant.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_inv
idris.note: One firing keeps the run invariant.

idris.name: iret_11_4__pump_ttl_clock
idris.note: Nor does a pump: the clock moves only at ticks.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl
idris.note: The bounded run, the deadline table threaded through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_inv
idris.note: A pump keeps the clocked invariant and the clock, however it halts.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_tms_unfold
idris.note: The engine's firing, given the selection, the rule and the token.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_ttl
idris.note: One firing, the deadline table threaded through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_ttl_clock
idris.note: A firing does not touch the clock.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_ttl_engine
idris.note: AGREEMENT: one firing with the deadline table is the engine's firing on the engine, so every theorem of Rete/TmsRun.idr and Lcyc/TmsTermination.idr about a firing holds here.

idris.name: iret_11_4__step_ttl_inv
idris.note: One firing keeps the clocked invariant and the clock: the run invariant and target kinds by agreement with the engine, the deadline table by the RHS's mints.
